# Image-engine job setter table

Per-job setter functions that write a job's parameter words, indexed by job number.

**Category:** table · **Address:** `0x60257b88` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Setters write into the parameter window from 0x9d000000 and set the job's program address. The OM-5 1.2 table is at 0x6025f8e8.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Table and window use read from the setters. Source: [E-M5 III image engine](../sources/em5n.image-engine.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Patching in the OM-5 job 12 setter made job 12 give verified output on the camera. Source: [Live ND on the E-M5 III](../sources/em5n.live-nd.md).
